rationale: The workflow has no explicit job timeout, so a runaway job could consume the default 360-minute limit. The repository CI history shows representative successful runs completing in roughly 1 minute, satisfying the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT precondition (representative successful-duration history exists). Adding explicit timeouts with operational headroom (10 min for the build job that installs dependencies and runs next build; 5 min for the fast pages deploy) bounds runaway consumption without changing any build/test step, permission, or deployment behavior, preserving required coverage. Dependency caching is already present via setup-node cache: npm, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated (equivalent cache already exists), and P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a GitHub Pages deployment workflow (release/deployment work).
